digest.component_or_area: codebase module hardening and structural organization
propositions: Six high-churn, high-centrality modules are at or near the 800-LOC file-size cap with critically low headroom, blocking dependent work like ticket d23e from landing without structural prerequisites

llm/config.py and llm/plan_review/workflow_ops.py must be relieved by extracting absorbing verbs and domain-specific logic into new modules (gate_context.py and decide_ops.py) to restore headroom below the enforced 700-LOC seam-test target
Seam tests asserting per-file headroom bounds and full plan-review step-registry membership must be added as load-bearing ratchets in place of the rejected per-function length gate
scripts/gen_env_registry.py has a defect where _llm_float is invisible to the scanner and must be fixed; all env vars read through helpers must be verified complete against docs/env-vars.md
